name: Yuca (Cassava)
siboNotes: Well-tolerated on SIBO diet as a starchy carbohydrate that's easily digestible and doesn't feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Peel thoroughly and remove the fibrous core before cooking
Boil, steam, or roast until tender - raw cassava contains compounds that must be cooked out
Can be mashed like potatoes or cut into fries
Store peeled cassava in water in the refrigerator for up to 3 days
nutritionalHighlights: High in resistant starch when cooled
